Name: Futanari Emily
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]I was looking at the Haley futa mod by milkbuny, and I liked it so much that I wrote to the mod's author to ask if he could do the same with Emily, but unfortunately, he never replied, meaning that I never will do that (⁠っ⁠˘̩⁠╭⁠╮⁠˘̩⁠)⁠っ[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]So I decided to do it myself, and with Ibis Paint X,[/color][color=#d4d4d8]I Modify Emily sprites so that she would have a [b]DONG[/b].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod contains the default sprites, the winter sprites, and the beach sprites (it took me a long time to make the winter sprites). [/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]It installs like any other Stardew Valley mod: install SMAPI, then Content Patcher, paste this mod into your mods folder, and that's it. There's no magic to it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]sprites edited,now Emily has a erect cock [/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]This mod includes all of Emily's edited sprites (wedding, beach, winter, and default).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]It includes an add-on that also edits Haley to turn her into a futa (unlike milkbuni's mod, this one includes beach sprites,Something the original mod doesn't have)[/color][/*]
[/list]
